name: Clockify (example)
_note: Save as clockify.json, fill in your workspace ID and store the API key in the Keychain from Schichta (Settings > Integrations). Placeholders: date, dateFormatted, author, totalMinutes, totalHours, totalDuration, entries; per entry entry.id, entry.ticket, entry.description, entry.minutes, entry.hours, entry.duration, entry.estimated, entry.project, entry.start/entry.end (UTC), entry.startTime/entry.endTime (HH:mm). {{map.ticket}} translates the ticket through the map table.
